newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say March growth slower.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say March growth slower.

text.p: The Cincinnati chapter of the National Association of Purchasing Management said Monday its March report indicated that growth moderated from February's growth rate.
"Consistently we saw a lower rate of increase in two of our three pricing indices and only a slight increase in commodity prices," the group said.
The moderation of the recovery was seen especially in new orders, backlog of orders and production, the group said, adding the rate of increase in employement was slightly lower than in February.
